narrative.overview:
A developer reference ruled like a railway timetable. Everything sits on one sheet, so more entries fit per screen, and a reader mid-task can search or scan, open a tool, find a section by name and size, read each entry top to bottom, and copy the command.

The sheet is white paper on cool grey in light mode and blue-black in dark mode. Mild 1px rules in two weights divide it; there is no radius and no shadow. One route blue does the wayfinding, and green marks the Neovim line. Geist sets prose and titles; Geist Mono sets reference labels and code.

The system refuses the airy docs page of floating cards and large display titles. Native Starlight behavior stays: search, sidebars, contents, theme control, and code copy are restyled, not replaced.
keyCharacteristics: One ruled sheet, with rules running edge to edge across the reading column.
Paired light and dark themes built from the same roles.
Section and entry counts drawn from the content, in the directory and the contents rail.
Vertical entries for command pages; ruled tables for shortcut pages.
Monochrome code with a route blue prompt, ink commands, and muted output.

rules.name: The One Route Rule
rules.body: Route blue is the only wayfinding color. Links, current state, focus, and prompts all use it, in both themes.

rules.name: The Neovim Line Rule
rules.body: Green only marks the Neovim collection with a square. It never sets text, links, or focus.

rules.name: The Paired Theme Rule
rules.body: Apply a theme's roles together. Every new surface must work in light and dark before it ships.

rules.name: The Reference Mono Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono sets tool names, section names on tool pages, keys, counts, and code. It never sets running text: prose, purpose lines, summaries, and table prose stay in Geist.

rules.name: The Compact Title Rule
rules.body: Titles stop at 2.125rem. Density comes first; the sheet does not open on a display headline.

rules.name: The One Sheet Rule
rules.body: Rules run edge to edge and sections sit flush. No gaps, gutters, or margins separate entries into floating blocks.

rules.name: The Shared Columns Rule
rules.body: From 60rem, Markdown tables use a fixed layout so column rules line up from one section's table to the next. Tables use a 13rem first column and a 34% second. Four-column tables use 9.5rem for the first two (11rem from 72rem) and 30% for the third.

rules.name: The Local Scroll Rule
rules.body: Wide code and tables scroll inside themselves; the page never scrolls sideways. Below 50rem, table columns after the first keep a 14rem minimum and the first column does not wrap.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Nothing lifts. If a surface needs separation, give it a rule or a tone.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: No radius on any new element, in either theme.

rules.name: The Plain Tint Rule
rules.body: Current state is a tint and a text color. No bar, border, dot, or marker.

rules.name: The Drawn Count Rule
rules.body: Section and entry counts come from the page content at build time, never typed by hand.

rules.name: The Vertical Entry Rule
rules.body: Entries flow top to bottom in a single column. Don't arrange them in side-by-side columns or grids.

rules.name: The Terminal Voices Rule
rules.body: Code is monochrome. In shell blocks the `$` is Route Blue, commands are Ink at 500, and output is Muted at 400. No syntax hues, in any language.

dos: **Do** apply light and dark roles together, and check every surface in both.
**Do** divide with the two 1px rule weights: Mild Rule between rows and entries, Strong Rule above sections and tables.
**Do** keep Geist for prose and titles, and Geist Mono for reference labels and code.
**Do** keep native Starlight search, sidebars, contents, theme control, and code copy.
**Do** hold 2.75rem targets on navigation and controls below 50rem, and scroll wide code and tables locally.
**Do** keep visible focus and reduced motion support on anything that moves.
donts: **Don't** add shadows, blur, or radius to any surface.
**Don't** float directory rows or entries as spaced cards, or open a page on a large display title.
**Don't** set prose, purpose lines, or summaries in Geist Mono.
**Don't** add `###` entries to the contents rail or a bar or marker to its current row.
**Don't** use Neovim green for text, links, or focus.
**Don't** hide Markdown table columns to fit narrow screens.
